as_told.title: Tesla's wireless transmission experiments at Wardenclyffe

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the early 1900s the inventor Nikola Tesla got money from the banker J.P. Morgan for experiments at Wardenclyffe, Tesla's laboratory in New York. According to Michels, the work was all about sending energy through the air without wires, though in another episode he describes it as wireless instantaneous transmission. He tells it as part of a wider claim that Tesla's technology went further than most people know.
